answer: A bond must be split across 5 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each plume escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the nebula ledger records every share and the ember audit publishes the split. Assembling that for 118 aliases means 118 times 5 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
